_doc: Overworld terrain look per era (docs/ERA_FEEL_TILES.md, scripts/overworld/EraTerrainLook.gd). A map takes the tier of its region's era, capped by the era on screen (Retro filter), so old regions keep their origin look: Era I = the four story acts, II Vellmarch, III Quillmarch, IV Halcyra, V Quivermoor. Each era keeps everything of the one before (EraTerrainLook.problems, tests/unit/test_era_overworld_look.gd): a switch never goes off again, a number never goes down, an animated kind never stops. anim.kinds: TilesetFactory.Kind name -> style (flip = mirrored second frame, sway = upper rows lean, scroll = the tile drifts sideways). raised atlases: tools/art/gen_era_raised.py.

shared._doc: Values every tier reads. sway_rows: how many upper rows of a tile lean. edge_onto / edge_from: bare ground that gets a ragged fringe from the green next to it. shore_kinds: water that gets a bank line and foam; shore_joins: neighbours that are no bank. reflect_from: kinds mirrored in the water cell below (the cut-out kinds of the raised atlas). flat: ground a contact shade may fall on. casters: kind -> height in px of its drop shadow. canopy: kind -> rows of the tile top drawn over the people. sun: per time of day (DayCycle.PHASE_NAMES) the shadow direction (x right, y down, per px of height) and strength; the tint of the hour itself is the light slice (data/era_light.json). banners: pennant colours (healer, shop, then houses and towers), flown from free tower tops and the ridge over every house door. parallax_ref: px of distance from the view centre per px of lean. town_zoom_time: seconds the view takes to settle in a town.
